title: Maru Ram v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Maru Ram v. Union of India, (1980) 2 SCC 107
content.holding: The pardoning power under Articles 72 and 161 is exercised by the President/Governor strictly on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers, not in personal discretion.
content.relevance: Aid and advice of cabinet governs clemency.
